senses.zh_definition: Rancho：人名或其他专名；在马来西亚电影评论中，可指《三傻大闹宝莱坞》的角色兰彻。
senses.en_definition: Rancho, a proper name; in Malaysian film commentary, the name of a character in 3 Idiots.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang, dalam ulasan filem 3 Idiots, merujuk kepada watak yang dilakonkan oleh Aamir Khan.
senses.nuances: 这是有文献支持的专名用法，不能据此断定资料包中的小写 rancho 必指该角色。正常行文应写 Rancho。以下为自然专名组合，不代表经语料统计确认的高频搭配；马来语释义为编辑释义，并非 DBP 原文。[马来西亚电影报道](https://www.mstar.com.my/spotlight/hiburan/2009/12/26/filem-3-idiots-selit-teladan-di-sebalik-elemen-lucu)

collocations.zh: 兰彻、法罕和拉朱的友谊
collocations.en: the friendship between Rancho, Farhan and Raju

senses.zh_definition: 〔西班牙语外语词〕在墨西哥等拉丁美洲地区，饲养马匹等牲畜的农场；牧场。
senses.en_definition: In Spanish, especially in parts of Latin America, a farm for raising horses and other livestock; a ranch.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Sepanyol di beberapa kawasan Amerika Latin, ladang untuk menternak kuda dan haiwan ternakan lain.
senses.nuances: 这是西班牙语释义，不能直接登记为已获 DBP 确认的马来语义项。一般马来语说明可用 ladang ternakan。以下组合属于解释外语词的表达，不是已证实的马来语高频搭配。[西班牙皇家学院词典](https://dle.rae.es/rancho)

collocations.zh: rancho 在西班牙语中的意思
collocations.en: the meaning of rancho in Spanish

messages.en: Yes. He wants to understand what he learns instead of just memorizing it.

etymology.historical_story: The spelling rancho has more than one cultural setting. Spanish dictionaries record it for several kinds of communal or rural establishments, including livestock farms. Malaysian film writing also uses Rancho as a character name in 3 Idiots. These separate uses do not establish an official Malay common noun or identify this packet’s intended referent.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先看语境再记义：电影里的 Rancho 是兰彻；西班牙语乡村语境中的 rancho 可指牧场。两者不要混记成一个马来语普通词。
